title: An integer-weighted bi-Lipschitz parametrized piece carries an integer multiplicity triple (area formula)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U ⊆ ℝ^P open. Let H : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be L-Lipschitz, B ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel and m > 0 with m|a − a'| ≤ |H(a) − H(a')| for a, a' ∈ B, H differentiable with injective derivative at every point of B, and H(B) ⊆ U. Write J(a) := (det(DH(a)*∘DH(a)))^{1/2} and Ae := (Ae₁, …, Aeₙ) for a linear A : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P. Let w : ℝⁿ → ℕ be measurable with w ≥ 1 on B, and ζ : ℝⁿ → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) a.e. strongly measurable for Lebesgue measure on B, such that for a.e. a ∈ B there is s ∈ {1, −1} with ζ(a)(α) = s·α(DH(a)e) for every n-covector α. Assume ∫_B w(a)J(a) da < ∞. Then there is an integer multiplicity triple R in U (IMRep U n) with mass μ_R(U) = R.measure U = ∫⁻_B w(a)J(a) da and with R.action(ω) = ∫_B w(a)·ζ(a)(ω(H(a))) da for every n-form ω : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, no regularity required).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (H : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ) (w : Euclid n → ℕ) (ζ : Euclid n → MultiVector P n), IsOpen U → LipschitzWith L H → MeasurableSet B → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖H a - H a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ H a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H a)) → H '' B ⊆ U → Measurable w → (∀ a ∈ B, 1 ≤ w a) → AEStronglyMeasurable ζ (volume.restrict B) → (∀ᵐ a ∂(volume.restrict B), ∃ s : ℝ, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ζ a α = s * α (fun j => fderiv ℝ H a (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) → ∫⁻ a in B, (w a : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ H a).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ H a).det)) ∂volume ≠ ∞ → ∃ R : IMRep U n, R.measure U = ∫⁻ a in B, (w a : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ H a).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ H a).det)) ∂volume ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R.action ω = ∫ a in B, (w a : ℝ) * ζ a (ω (H a)) ∂volume
